summary: Register PH-230 (cash posting slice: draft cash transactions become immutable posted facts with one canonical cash.transaction_recorded event and read-only account coverage; no ledger/classification/clearing/refund) and PH-231 next planning slot. No product code changed.

deviations: PH-230 is a deliberately narrow slice of PH-169: it posts bank facts (status/event/coverage) but writes no AccountingEvent/LedgerPosting/LedgerEntry and performs no classification/allocation/clearing/refund/correction/transfer/import/opening balance; those remain later slices.

PH-230 dependencies are the done cash/AR slices rather than the still-proposed PH-169/170/171, because posting only needs the PH-228 cash facts plus core periods; remaining scope stays tracked by later planning.
Posting is not described as cash-book entry: the canonical event carries posting_event_refs=[] and the spec explicitly says no ledger bridge in this slice.
unverified: No product code, migration, tests, browser, PostgreSQL or CI evidence exists for PH-230 yet.
Cash classification, ledger bridge, clearing (PH-170), refunds (PH-171), bank-file import and opening balances are not designed here; PH-169 is not complete.
